implemented_source.lazy_default_off: Import/disabled construction does not load WinDLL or probe targets. Future reads require this adapter explicitly enabled; enabling it cannot implement the missing transfer.
implemented_source.fixed_preload_opener: CreateFileW GENERIC_READ / FILE_SHARE_READ / OPEN_EXISTING, no caller share flags. Own handle is retained; final DOS and NT names, 64-bit volume and 128-bit FileID and size are rechecked. No post-hoc arbitrary handle adoption.
implemented_source.same_handle_hash: Read-only mapping hashes the continuously held file itself, without reopening a path or changing a shared file pointer. Unknown unmap/close remains retained for explicit retry.
implemented_source.process: Read-only owned duplicate: QUERY_INFORMATION | VM_READ | SYNCHRONIZE, no write/terminate rights. Kernel PID/GetProcessTimes integer FILETIME/full image plus WaitForSingleObject(handle,0). Only WAIT_TIMEOUT is alive; signaled is dead; other states reject. All seven FILETIME fraction digits are retained; frozen issuer refuses nonrepresentable precision rather than truncating.
implemented_source.module: Complete bounded module roster is read before/after, including same-basename foreign modules. FileID is associated only with a continuous preload lease matching both full loader DOS and kernel mapped NT paths; unrelated modules retain unknown IDs. No module path reopen or basename-only selection supplies file identity.
implemented_source.pipe: bind_server_endpoint borrows the actual canonical NativeNamedPipeServer current instance and validated pipe_name. Kernel reader requires server end via GetNamedPipeInfo, then GetNamedPipeClientProcessId. Instance and name are checked before/after peer observation.
implemented_source.cleanup: Only own target read duplicate, fixed DLL file and temporary mapping/view handles are released. Runtime original target/job and actual SDK server pipe remain borrowed. Unknown release retains ownership for retry. The facade close methods are for pre-adoption abort or release after custody has already cleared its DTO; they are not installed owner invalidators.
implemented_source.token: No new qualification token, JSON proof, public RPC or owner/parser/driver mutation. Existing guarded issuer remains the only branch that could mint the existing M7 private DTO/seal.
